question: why the RIBES CFD produced physically impossible numbers
verdict: the laser-scan point set contains the model's internal structure; 19.5% of its points are not on the wetted surface

chain_of_evidence.finding: c_p oscillates only forward of x/c 0.27
chain_of_evidence.measurement: walking the ring in index order, 29 of 156 cells have |dc_p| > 0.5, all at x/c < 0.27; max jump 3.543. Aft of x/c 0.30, c_p sits flat at -0.22 for 70% of the chord, which is a separated wake.

chain_of_evidence.finding: the section fed to the mesher is corrugated in that same band
chain_of_evidence.measurement: slope-jump median over x/c 0.01-0.35 was 0.0276 against 0.00080 for an analytic NACA 0012 on the identical grid: 34.5x the floor.

chain_of_evidence.finding: the corrugation is not shape the fit was failing to capture
chain_of_evidence.measurement: CST residual stayed at 1.16% of chord from n=6 to n=20 coefficients. A 21-coefficient CST fits any real aerofoil to under 0.05%, so a residual that will not fall is scatter, not shape.

chain_of_evidence.finding: the scatter is the model's internal structure
chain_of_evidence.measurement: 15 of 17 sections carry a vertical column of points at x/c 0.19-0.21 -- the main spar web. 1040 of 5335 scan points (19.5%) lie strictly inside the z-envelope. Section 1100 is 66.8% interior.

chain_of_evidence.finding: sorting by polar angle interleaved them into the surface ring
chain_of_evidence.measurement: walking the upper surface in ring order, 35 of 186 steps go backward in x, the worst by -0.3028 chord.

why_it_survived_validation: the old section agreed with the 30 pressure taps to 0.074% of chord. The corrugation lives BETWEEN the taps, so tap agreement could not see it. Agreement at sparse points is not a smoothness test.

fix.reject_interior: a scan point is interior if, within +/-1% chord in x, material lies both above and below it. The wetted surface is the z-envelope of the cloud; a spar point cannot be on it.
fix.cst: Kulfan CST with 8 coefficients per surface: z = x^0.5 (1-x) sum A_i B_i(x) + x z_te. The nose is structural, so smoothness does not trade against fit.

tap_agreement_pct_chord.note: both metrics improve together, which is why this is a fix not a trade

solver_confirmation.condition: RIBES T40 measured: M 0.11494, Re 1.3286e6 on 0.5153 m MAC, 298.85 K, S_ref 0.815 m2, alpha 0.36 deg
solver_confirmation.decisive_quantity: C_Dv. Skin friction cannot nearly vanish on a wing at Re 1.3e6. 4.10 counts was the impossible number; 79.2 is physical, against about 93.8 counts for the AERIS g83 wing at comparable Reynolds.

after_converged.note: alpha 0.36 at the RIBES T40 measured condition, gci2_C on the cleaned section

unverified: the three other incidences (-1.94, 4.75, 8.12) were still solving when this was written
C_L 0.2487 is a wing coefficient; the 0.2638 and 0.2260 it is held against are SECTIONAL values at two spanwise stations, so this is a consistency check, not a like-for-like validation
